summary_md: **Louis ([@FlouisLF](https://x.com/FlouisLF/status/2115071210413601233))** runs four coding agents on one RTX 3090 at ~290 tok/s total via a custom CUDA engine for Qwen3.8-27B in **open-jet** (3–4x llama-server --parallel): one pass over the weights serves all agents with a shared 132K KV pool. A reply notes it suits shorter tasks given the VRAM limit.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - L-Forster/open-jet: An offline coding agent for local models. One command sets up the best model your GPU can run, and on 24 GB+ RTX 30/40/50-series cards Qwen3.8-27B runs up to 1.9x faster than llama.cpp.

relevance: Multi-agent batched serving of a ~27B model on a single consumer GPU.

media.description: Demo video of four coding agents sharing one RTX 3090 via open-jet's CUDA engine (not downloaded; referenced only).
